newsitem.title: USA: Ponder says Hekmet has 6.0 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Ponder says Hekmet has 6.0 pct stake.

text.p: Ponder Industries Inc said Tuesday that investor Mohsen Hekmet, an Australian engineer who resides in London, has acquired a 6.0 percent stake in the company.

Ponder said Hekmet recently bought 740,000 common shares of the company for $1.42 million or about $2.02 a share. Ponder said Hekmet has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to disclose his stake.
Larry Armstrong, Ponder's chairman and chief executive officer, said Hekmet and the company worked together in the past year to establish joint venture business in the Middle East.
Ponder is an international oil field service and rental tool company. It specializes in the use of fishing tools for the recovery of obstructions in the bore holes of oil and gas wells.
